prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
promptZh: 請聽錄音，選出最適當的回應。
spokenPrompt: The painter needs all the inside doors open, but I can't have the cat wandering from room to room.
spokenPromptZh: 油漆師傅需要屋內所有的門都開著，但我不能讓貓在各個房間亂跑。

options.text: I can keep the cat at my place while the painter's there.
options.zh: 師傅施工時，我可以把貓留在我家照顧。
options.whyZh: 把貓暫時安置到別處，同時滿足室內門全開和貓不能亂跑兩個條件。

options.text: We could keep the bedroom door shut until the painter leaves.
options.zh: 我們可以先關著臥室門，等師傅離開再開。
options.whyZh: 需要關一扇室內門，違反師傅需要所有室內門打開的條件。

options.text: The painter said the front door can stay closed.
options.zh: 師傅說大門可以保持關著。
options.whyZh: 大門關好只能防止貓跑出屋外，不能避免貓在屋內到處跑。

explanationZh: 把貓暫時安置到別處，同時滿足室內門全開和貓不能亂跑兩個條件。

vocabulary.note: 指貓會趁屋內門開著時到處走動。
表示可把貓安置在說話者家中。

evidence: The painter needs all the inside doors open, but I can't have the cat wandering from room to room. / I can keep the cat at my place while the painter's there.
